messages:
Rina: Tiny midweek morale check: who wants to start a 'micro-kudos' chain? Say one thing you're grateful for and tag the next person. :sparkles:
Pat: I'm in. grateful for the noisy ficus that reminds me to stand up every hour. tagging @Diego
Diego: Love it. grateful for the person who stocked the espresso pods. tagging @Rina
Rina: grateful for Pat's impeccable snack radar. tagging @Pat :cookie:
Pat: I accept the responsibility. also bonus one-liner request: drop a 6-word office haiku (ok maybe 6-ish).
Diego: "Meeting ended. my brain filed for leave."
Rina: "Keyboard crumbs love my desk crumbs."
Pat: "Email: unread. Me: emotionally unavailable."
ink-bot: FYI: whiteboard markers restocked in supply closet. :package: (automated service message)
Rina: Also, quick poll: who wants a team trivia night on Friday? vote with emoji: :game_die: yes, :zzz: no
Pat: :game_die:
Diego: :game_die:
Rina: two yeses, trivia locked. planning thread incoming.
Pat: tiny brag: finally fixed that weird linter warning from last sprint. small victories. :confetti_ball:
Diego: cheers to that. bringing celebratory stickers for all on Friday. :star2:
Rina: ok that's a win. chain continues: tagging @Diego to pass to someone new.
Diego: tagging @Maya (outside this thread) — consider yourself kudoed. :heart:
metadata_note: Single Slack thread string. Short, informal messages with emoji, tag mentions, a bot notice, a tiny poll, and quick one-liners. No title field per agents.md rules.
